title: Data Science Trainer
description:
**Department**
==============

**Experience:**
===============


1 \- 3


**Employment type:**
====================


Full Time


**Location:**
=============


Ahmedabad


  
**About Us:**
=============


Itvedant was started with the aim of bridging the gap between education and skills needed for the job with an intense passion for teaching. We are looking for dynamic and passionate people from the software industry to be a part of our family who can lead the team of students towards a bright future.


**Job Summary:**


As a **Data Science Trainer**, your role will be to deliver engaging training in Data Science, Analytics, Machine Learning, and Business Intelligence while mentoring learners through practical, industry\-focused projects.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**


* Conduct engaging classroom and online training in Data Science, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, AI, Python, SQL, and related technologies.
* Ability to simplify complex concepts and explain them in a clear, engaging, and easy\-to\-understand manner.
* Mentor and evaluate learners through doubt\-solving, coding support, project guidance, assessments, performance tracking, and career preparation including portfolios, resumes, and interviews.
* Continuously enhance training programs by learning resources with emerging technologies, while collaborating with content teams.

**Job Qualification \& Skill Sets:**


* 1–8 years of experience in teaching technical courses at an EdTech or educational institute, with a strong passion for teaching and empowering students to build successful careers in Data Science
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field.
* Ability to effectively address and resolve students queries with clarity and patience.

**Perks \& Benefits:**


* Exciting Opportunity to Win Domestic \& International Trips.
* Strong Career Growth \& Advancement Opportunities.
* A Growth\-Oriented Culture That Recognizes \& Rewards Your Success
* Opportunity to upgrade in terms of knowledge \& Skills.

title: Solutions Architect, AI
description:
**Experience:** 5 to 10 years


**Location:** Ahmedabad


**Department:** Machine Learning

  

**About Simform:**


Simform is a premier digital engineering company specialising in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform has strong capabilities across Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 6 countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market. Simform is well\-recognised as one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work\-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.

  

**Role Overview:**


We are seeking a Solution Architect specializing in AI and Machine Learning to lead and design enterprise\-grade AI solutions. This role requires expertise in Agentic AI, Data Science, and MLOps, along with a strong passion for innovation, customer engagement, leadership, and problem\-solving..

  

**Key Responsibilities:**


* **AI Solution Design:** Architect complex Agentic AI solutions with layered AI services, logic, and data readiness practices, focusing on Generative AI and LLMs. Design scalable enterprise solutions aligned with business requirements.
* **MLOps Leadership**: Implement and promote MLOps best practices for scalable, efficient AI/ML workflows.
* **Technical Leadership:** Mentor and lead AI engineers, ensuring technical excellence and successful project delivery.
* **Customer \& Presales Collaboration:** Participate in presales discussions, interact with customers to understand business requirements, and translate business objectives into AI\-driven solutions by partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* **Innovation**: Stay updated on advancements in AI to foster team and organizational growth.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in developing ML\-powered services and algorithms.
* Proven track record of building enterprise\-scale AI/ML solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Generative AI/LLMs and tools like LangChain, LangSmith, Semantic Kernel, Autogen, and Haystack.
* Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, R, and diverse ML algorithms.
* Familiarity with Azure/AWS ML stack.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience in solution design, customer interaction, and presales activities.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead cross\-functional teams effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Passion for innovation and implementing cutting\-edge technologies.
* Ability to drive strategy and vision for AI/ML adoption in enterprise settings.

**Why Join Us:**


* Flat\-hierarchical, friendly, engineering\-oriented, and growth\-focused culture.
* Young Team, Thriving Culture
* Flexible work timings, additional leaves for life events, and WFH , hybrid options.
* Well\-balanced learning and growth opportunities
* Free health insurance.
* Office facility with a fully\-equipped game zone, affordable lunch service, and free snacks.
* Sponsorship for certifications/events and access to a library service.
